resolutions.conform: the code changes to match the workbook
resolutions.ratify: the workbook is updated to match what the code verified (the code is right)
resolutions.retire: the code rule is removed (decision D-009)
resolutions.keep: the difference is an identity, not a defect (decision D-010)
resolutions.review: undecided: conform or ratify, per rule
